text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The day of the long-awaited Make Debut had 
arrived! And there in the stands was 
Taiki, looking right at me with an ardent 
gaze!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right, we are the strongest pair of 
our generation! In that case, I'll be the 
first to hit you with it! A super intense 
greeting!
